integratedBehavior: Put hashes plaintext while streaming, writes authenticated envelopes under project-keyed opaque paths, fsyncs and verifies before guarded publication, commits strict metadata including a closed technical creation-source category, and reconciles lost acknowledgements without publishing partial or conflicting content.

Open enforces project authority, rights, metadata/envelope integrity, key availability, and a dependency-neutral declared-purpose access policy before path resolution or decryption. Known local reads are allowed by default; controlled egress and malformed or unknown purposes fail closed unless an injected policy returns an exact bounded allow decision.

Supported prior plaintext profiles pass through the default executable pre-open v4 copy-on-write coordinator. Every journal/fsync/rename/verification/metadata/cancellation boundary restarts to one verified authority, retaining the source until encrypted production open succeeds.

Governed migration v0005 advances verified v1-v4 history to the current schema, truthfully backfills legacy-unreported creation source, preserves historical fingerprints, and produces fresh/migrated fingerprint parity.

Usage and preview distinguish durable metadata/objects, rebuildable derivatives, orphans, indexes, project/shared caches, models, configuration, exports, and operational state. Hard quota or free-space pressure denies new writes while verified reads and cleanup remain available.

Cleanup consumes one random preview, transactionally rechecks canonical references and readers, binds canonical and rebuildable deletion to the exact previewed Windows file generation through a held handle, and skips a same-digest object republished after preview. Restart deletes only a partial whose full identity matches its filename commitment; replacement generations, hardlinks, redirects, and forged partials are preserved or fail closed.
